title: everybody-should-be-talking-to-the-inference-domain-via-the-bus
intention: every device should reach inference_domain through the bus, not by importing it directly
why: device_isolation ruling says only db_domain is exempt from cross-device import ban. librarian (and others) currently import inference_domain directly for embeddings. The bus is the sole path for inter-device comms — direct imports violate both the ruling and the bus design.
traces_to: Law 6 (everything has exactly one owner), no-cross-device-imports ruling, provider-doesn't-know-consumers principle

falsifier.proves_green: grep -r from.cairn.devices.inference_domain across all devices other than inference_domain itself returns zero hits; every inference call routes through bus.request() or bus.post()
falsifier.proves_red: any device other than inference_domain still imports from cairn.devices.inference_domain directly after the fix

constraints: db_domain is the sole cross-device import exemption — inference_domain gets no exemption
bus.request() is the inter-device call path; bus.post() for fire-and-forget
how: each device that imports inference_domain directly gets refactored to use bus verbs instead. inference_domain exposes its capabilities as bus verbs (embed, infer, etc.).
links: related: 50ad391f4e95 (aider-shim-reaches-into-inference-domain — same root cause, scoped to aider_shim)
dependencies: inference_domain must expose embed/infer as bus verbs
measurements_since_cast: 2026-08-30: import_sieve flags direct imports from inference_domain across multiple devices
